tm.ちから ＋{var:8} すばやさ ＋{var:9} みのまもり ＋{var:1: Str. +{var:8}  Agi. +{var:9}  Res. +{var:10}{x:000A}Dex. +{var:11}  Charm +{var:12}{x:000D}{x:000A}Mag. might +{var:13}  Mag. mend +{var:14}
tm.「ソルッチャ運河を抜け 内海の中心にそびえる\n 光の柱で マーメイドハープを使: Through the Soltcha Canal, then play the Mermaid harp at the inner sea's pillar of light to reach the undersea kingdom, right?
tm.「王の私室へと続く 抜け道は\n 大食堂の奥にある台所の 食器棚の裏にある。\n: The way to the king's chamber is behind the kitchen cupboard past the dining hall. It leads up to the throne room.
tm.「サンポ大僧正が お前を冥府に送るため\n 山頂の聖域で 待っているはずだ。\n: High Priest Sampo waits at the summit shrine to send you to the Underworld. Let's hurry up Mount Pang Lai.
tm.「冥府で 何があったかは 全部聞いてるわ。\n アナタとロウちゃんが 大師のもと: I heard all about the Underworld. You and Rab trained under the Master and learned the Luminary's legendary arts.
tm.「ところで ジャコラが現れた海には\n 光の柱が そびえる場所があったわ。\n: By the way, there was a pillar of light where Jarvis appeared. {var:1}, you know what comes next, right?
tm.「グロッタで 姫さまを苦しめていた魔物も\n 最後の砦を襲っていた魔物も\n た: The monster that hurt the princess in Octagonia and the one at the Last Bastion both called themselves Sea Kings...
tm.「招かれざる何者かが 上陸したのかもしれん。\n ……この先 どうなるか わから: An unwelcome visitor may have landed. Anything could happen. Get ready, then go to the harbor-side main gate.
tm.「姫さまは ひさびさの旅に ゴキゲンのご様子。\n ハメを外して 危険なことをな: The princess is excited for her first trip in ages. I'm to make sure she doesn't do anything reckless.
tm.「地上を離れ 空に浮かぶ島……。\n 先代勇者の記憶を伝える 聖なる苗木……。\: Floating islands... sacred saplings holding the last Luminary's memories... The surface has nothing like this.
tm.「伝説の宝珠を集め 地の底で出会う\n 勇者にチカラを貸せ さすれば\n お前の: "Gather the orbs and aid the Luminary you meet in the depths of the earth, and your atonement will be complete..."
tm.「間違いない……この預言を与えてくれたのは\n デルカコスタで会った 預言者だっ: That prophecy must be from the prophet at the Emerald Coast. He looked like an old man when I saw him.
tm.「我ら イシの民。大地の精霊と共にあり……。\n イシの民は 歴史に残らない ず: "We of Cobblestone live with the earth spirits..." Its people have lived under the spirits' blessing since ancient times.
tm.「……なんとか 魔物たちから 町を救えたわね。\n でも 黒い太陽の影響で 凶暴: ...We saved the town from the monsters. But other towns must be suffering too, now the black sun has made monsters violent.
tm.「この町を襲う魔物は かなりの強敵のようじゃ。\n 早く 町を救いたいと あせる: These monsters are formidable. I know you want to save the town fast, but sometimes a brave retreat is needed.
tm.「そういえば 先代勇者ローシュと旅していた\n 伝説の戦士ネルセンは 旅を終えた: I read that Nelsen, the warrior who traveled with the Luminary Erdwin, founded Bunderfon after their journey.
tm.「……その旅も いよいよ 大詰めのようです。\n 先代勇者ですら倒しきれなかった: ...Our journey nears its end. Even the last Luminary couldn't finish this evil god. Prepare, then face the final battle.
tm.「ドゥーランダの山頂は 古来より\n 生と死のはざまの世界……冥府と通じる\n: Since ancient times, Mount Dooran's summit has been a sacred place linked to the underworld between life and death.
tm.「勇者のつるぎは ロトゼタシアの希望の象徴。\n ニズゼルファとの戦いが 終わっ: The Sword of Light is Erdrea's symbol of hope. Now that Calasmos is beaten, it should go back where it belongs.
tm.持てるコインの限界を 超えています。\nこれ以上 持てませんが 遊びますか？:
You're at the token limit.
You can't carry any more. Play anyway?
tm.なんと この扉が\n時渡りの迷宮の 最後の扉のようだ！\nついに 時渡りの迷宮を:
This is the last door of the Labyrinth of Time!
You've finally conquered it!
tm.持てるコインの 限界を越えています。\nこれ以上 持てませんが 遊びますか？:
You're at the token limit.
You can't carry any more. Play anyway?
tm.本体設定のすれちがい通信管理で\nほかのソフトのすれちがい通信をやめてから\nす:
Turn off another title's StreetPass
in System Settings,
then start StreetPass again.
